## Où j'en suis
Built the Dashboards v2 grid (drag + resize via react-grid-layout, behind the `dashboards_v2` flag), with server-side layout persistence (`PUT /dashboards/:id/layout`) plus a localStorage fallback, widget sizing via a ResizeObserver hook (iOS 15 Safari doesn't support container queries), the `DashboardTile` → `WidgetCard` rename, and the Storybook build fix. Draft PR opened with a final commit for rename + Storybook fix, awaiting Priya's UX review before the Zest demo on Tuesday the 24th.

- [en-cours] PR #418 open (draft), waiting on Priya's UX review on the iPad tomorrow
- [prochaine-étape] Enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace only in the flags admin before the demo
- [essai-raté] Container queries for widget sizing: ignored by iOS 15 Safari, replaced by a `useWidgetSize()` ResizeObserver hook
- [essai-raté] Storybook build failed on CSS import from `node_modules` subpath; fixed by moving the import to `.storybook/preview.ts` and adding `react-grid-layout` to `optimizeDeps.include`
- [décision] Layout persisted server-side via `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout` (source: t03)
- [décision] Single sizing system: ResizeObserver, container queries dropped (source: t09)
- [décision] v1 dashboards stay behind the flag until January; nothing removed now (source: t15)
